title: Silence and Inventory
author: Rafael Blackwood
blurb: Orsen Eastwick, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
